title: Align host Codex policy with D18 and D9
body:
Outcome: Codex default model and effort follow D18 (gpt-6-luna, not gpt-6.1-sol xhigh), one codex-worker copy is on the delegation path, and the untracked shell-parsing hook krn-merge-guard.sh is retired or replaced per D9; codex usage per slice is measured before and after (memory codex-usage-burn).
Evidence: .krn/runs/program-audit/synthesis.md (operator grant ./grant.md, 2026-11-01).
